Furthermore, there are elements that also

comments: Given the sentence above it's actually not quite clear whether any of those things are actually intended to have payoff here or whether these things are more troll. The body beyond the river being nonexistent makes more sense as it reveals Miki's lies and Kiri's credulity, though Taichi's white hair and kimono would be what makes Kiri and Miki think it's him in a simpler (but false) explanation; the name Mimimi doesn't have any meaning that's explained here. Curiously, 兼ねて also means "to find difficult", but outside of blatant troll, I can't see where that reading would fit. -GHS

comments: Taichi B should be the Taichi we see here - which isn't a separate Taichi, if there's a separation it's between Taichi Full (spirit + body, sinner but redeemable) and Taichi Of This World (the pure irredeemable sinner).

The plan seems to have been that this Taichi would either participate with the rest, or be the actual killer. Of course, if this is just Real Taichi having a nervous breakdown and recovering, all that's not been written is the exact part where we'd see that. If the troll is that the "8" mentioned are just his hallucinations, then the entirety of CC takes place in his mind, and that's a valid if obviously inadequate troll of an explanation. Again, that part having not been written explicitly doesn't exclude it from being what happens.
Besides, it's still not as trolly as the Sakakibara diary. -GHS
